metaData.title: Big News! "AIGC Painting - Character Design White Paper - Volume 1" Released Today!
metaData.oneSentenceSummary: This article serves as a visual dictionary for AIGC character painting, systematically organizing Chinese and English terminology across three major categories: hairstyles, hair accessories, and clothing, accompanied by numerous example images to help users accurately describe character appearances.
metaData.summary: The article begins with the concept of "words failing to convey meaning," pointing out that in the AIGC era, precise language description is key to obtaining high-quality generated content. Based on the author's own learning needs, they have compiled a reference guide titled "AIGC Painting - Character Design White Paper." This first volume focuses on three fundamental elements of character design: hairstyles (including subcategories such as partings, bangs, ponytails, buns, length, texture, braids, and vintage styles), hair accessories (including subcategories such as hair clips, hair ties, headbands, bows, hairpins, jewelry, flowers, and stylized items), and clothing (covering modern basic garments, structural details, historical Chinese costumes, traditional attire from various countries, professional uniforms, sportswear, and formal/stage wear). Each subcategory lists precise Chinese-English terms paired with example images generated by GPT-Image-2. Essentially, this article is a practical reference manual for AIGC painting creators, aimed at helping users build a vocabulary of visual elements and improve the precision of their prompt writing.

mainPoints.point: Precise language description is the core ability to achieve high-quality output in the AIGC era.
mainPoints.explanation: The author believes that large models are essentially mappings of semantic spaces. Without rich and accurate language to describe, users cannot obtain high-quality outputs, which determines their efficiency and capability in the AIGC era.

mainPoints.point: This article is a systematic visual dictionary for AIGC character design, focusing on three major categories: hairstyles, hair accessories, and clothing.
mainPoints.explanation: The article organizes basic visual elements of character design in a Chinese-English bilingual glossary format, with each term accompanied by example images, helping users accumulate precise prompt vocabulary.

mainPoints.point: The article content is generated by GPT-Image-2, showcasing the application of AI in creating visual reference materials.
mainPoints.explanation: All example images in the article are generated by GPT-Image-2, which itself is a practical application of AIGC tools, demonstrating the potential of AI-assisted content creation.

keyQuotes: Humans have built large language models, image generation models, and video generation models as mappings of semantic spaces. Therefore, if you cannot use rich and accurate language to describe, you cannot obtain the high-quality deliverables you expect from the models and the Agents they drive.
I hope this content will be helpful in your journey of learning AIGC painting, allowing you to experience less 'words failing to convey meaning' and more 'words manifesting reality'!
